For the containment locus, cover both Grassmannians by their finitely many standard affine charts. On a product of two such charts, the planes $A$ and $B$ have canonical row-frame matrices. Thus the containment locus is closed on every member of this finite open cover. Closedness is local on an open cover, so it is closed globally. Together with steps 1.1--2.1 this proves both assertions without choosing global basis vectors of the varying plane $A$.
